title: Lakefront Loop with Buddy
description: Beautiful morning run along the lakefront. Buddy was all smiles the whole way — this guy is FAST when he wants to be.

title: Trail Day with Luna
description: Luna absolutely crushed the trails today. Her husky endurance is no joke — she was pulling me up the hills!

title: Neighborhood Cruise with Tank
description: Easy-going jog through Bay View. Tank stopped to greet every single person we passed. This dude is a social butterfly.

title: Sunset Sprint with Pepper
description: Pepper's last run before she got adopted! She went out with a bang — 5 miles at sunset on the Oak Leaf Trail. We'll miss you, girl.
